bluetooth_confirm.description: Set up {name}? Disable the official Oral-B integration entry for this brush first to avoid duplicate entities.

abort.not_supported: Device is not a supported Oral-B toothbrush
abort.no_devices_found: No Oral-B toothbrush found. Wake the brush (press its button) and try again.

init.description: Choose whether Home Assistant should cooperate with the charger/app or own the brush connection directly. A paired iO Sense is discovered and matched automatically.

options.charger_priority: Charger/app compatible (recommended) — automatically uses a paired iO Sense as a local live-data bridge and falls back safely when no charger is available
options.live: Home Assistant direct — uses the brush connection for the fastest notifications; the iO Sense display and phone app cannot use the brush simultaneously
